themes: Signs in the horizons and in ourselves
summary_for_children: Fussilat means Explained in Detail. It speaks of how Allah formed the heavens from smoke and the earth, and shows how still earth comes alive with rain.
environment_concept: A sky of drifting mist (41:11), a still dry plain (41:39) that stirs and sprouts when rain falls (41:39).
architecture_and_scenery: Swirling haze resolving into layered sky, a flat stilled plain, and sprouting hills.

palette.lighting: Hazy diffuse light clearing to blue

areas.name: Heaven as Smoke
areas.description: A sky of drifting smoke that clears into layers.

areas.name: Quivering Growth
areas.description: The plain stirs and sprouts when rain falls.

activities.name: Clear the sky
activities.description: Watch smoke settle into seven layers and lamps of stars (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Rain and growth
activities.description: Carry rain clouds to the still earth; it stirs and grows.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration stays with the ayahs and invites reflection on signs in the horizons (41:53).
learning_objectives: Explain rain as a sign of life

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (cloud, grain) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

primary_mechanic.text: Use a telescope to find signs on the horizons and in the land (41:53); green a barren slope after rain (41:39).

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Earth and the Sky
story_library.children_narration: The Quran invites us to look at the earth beneath our feet and the sky above our heads. It reminds us of the signs of creation and encourages people to respond to harmful behavior with what is better. Even a dry landscape can come alive after rain.

world_idea.title: The Earth and Sky Observatory
world_idea.description: Explore mountains, valleys, and a night sky; use a telescope-style discovery system and watch a barren landscape become green after rainfall.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
